title: Using meta-analysis and machine learning to investigate the transcriptional response of immune cells to Leishmania infection.
authors: Rezaei, Zahra; Tahmasebi, Ahmad; Pourabbas, Bahman
one_liner_zh: 该文用元分析和机器学习分析免疫细胞对利什曼原虫感染的转录组响应，虽涉及转录因子家族但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Leishmaniasis is a parasitic disease caused by the Leishmania protozoan affecting millions of people worldwide, especially in tropical and subtropical regions. The immune response involves the activation of various cells to eliminate the infection. Understanding the complex interplay between Leishmania and the host immune system is crucial for developing effective treatments against this disease. METHODS: This study collected extensive transcriptomic data from macrophages, dendritic, and NK cells exposed to Leishmania spp. Our objective was to determine the Leishmania-responsive genes in immune system cells by applying meta-analysis and feature selection algorithms, followed by co-expression analysis. RESULTS: As a result of meta-analysis, we discovered 703 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), primarily associated with the immune system and cellular metabolic processes. In addition, we have substantiated the significance of transcription factor families, such as bZIP and C2H2 ZF, in response to Leishmania infection. Furthermore, the feature selection techniques revealed the potential of two genes, namely G0S2 and CXCL8, as biomarkers and therapeutic targets for Leishmania infection. Lastly, our co-expression analysis has unveiled seven hub genes, including PFKFB3, DIAPH1, BSG, BIRC3, GOT2, EIF3H, and ATF3, chiefly related to signaling pathways. CONCLUSIONS: These findings provide valuable insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying the response of immune system cells to Leishmania infection and offer novel potential targets for the therapeutic goals.
abstract_zh: 背景：利什曼病是一种由利什曼原虫（Leishmania）引起的寄生虫病，影响全球数百万人，尤其是在热带和亚热带地区。免疫反应涉及多种细胞的激活以消除感染。理解利什曼原虫与宿主免疫系统之间的复杂相互作用对于开发针对该疾病的有效治疗至关重要。方法：本研究收集了暴露于利什曼原虫属（Leishmania spp.）的巨噬细胞、树突状细胞和NK细胞的大量转录组数据。我们的目标是通过应用荟萃分析（meta-analysis）和特征选择算法，随后进行共表达分析，来确定免疫系统细胞中对利什曼原虫响应的基因。结果：通过荟萃分析，我们发现了703个差异表达基因（DEGs），主要与免疫系统和细胞代谢过程相关。此外，我们证实了转录因子家族（如bZIP和C2H2 ZF）在利什曼原虫感染响应中的重要性。进一步地，特征选择技术揭示了两个基因（即G0S2和CXCL8）作为利什曼原虫感染的生物标志物和治疗靶点的潜力。最后，我们的共表达分析揭示了七个枢纽基因，包括PFKFB3、DIAPH1、BSG、BIRC3、GOT2、EIF3H和ATF3，主要与信号通路相关。结论：这些发现为免疫系统细胞对利什曼原虫感染响应的分子机制提供了宝贵见解，并为治疗目标提供了新的潜在靶点。
